title: Kernel phase signals and weighted span summaries for runtime telemetry
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Add a lightweight, phase-aware telemetry layer that emits per-kernel weighted span summaries and NVTX breadcrumb ranges to improve attribution of latency and cost across prefill and decode paths. This ticket focuses on signal design, minimal payload schema, and integration hooks for the trace ingestion pipeline so we can query kernel-phase costs without sampling every request.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime emits phase-tagged NVTX ranges for prefill and decode that can be correlated with trace spans
Per-kernel metrics include kernel_id, phase, duration_ms, cuda_stream, and estimated_flops (where available)
A compact weighted-span summary for each request is stored in the telemetry pipeline (S3/ClickHouse) and is queryable by request_id in the console

End-to-end test demonstrating a 10x reduction in telemetry volume for steady-state profiling compared to full per-kernel dump, while retaining >90% attribution accuracy for top-10 latency contributors
A migration guide and runtime feature flag to enable/disable phase telemetry in Dedicated and Private deployments
Feature review and sign-off from Security (for NVTX content) and Observability SRE
tasks: Design weighted-span summary schema and compression strategy
Implement phase tagging (prefill/decode/overlap) in runtime kernel scheduler
Add NVTX breadcrumb boundaries emitted around grouped kernel batches
Wire kernel metadata (kernel_id, selected_kernel_variant) into span annotations
Add ingest path in telemetry pipeline: decoder that expands weighted-span summaries into queries for console
Add unit and integration tests; benchmark telemetry volume vs baseline
comments: 2025-02-20 — Aisha Kapoor: Initial ticket created after postmortem for increased token latency on 2025-02-17. Goal is to get better coarse-grained attribution without full trace sampling.

2025-02-23 — Liam O'Reilly: Spike completed — prototype emits NVTX ranges + a compressed 3-field summary (phase,duration,top-k-kernel-ids). See spike notes: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1SpikeNotes

2025-02-25 — Nia Gomez (Observability): Reviewed schema; suggests including cuda_stream and fifo_slot for correlating with scheduler buckets. Also recommends a versioned schema for forward compatibility.

2025-02-27 — Engineering review: Decided to use an LZ4-compressed JSON line for weighted-span summaries to simplify pipeline ingestion; trade-off is CPU overhead on emitter but reduces network/storage by ~6x in local tests.

2025-03-01 — Security review: NVTX metadata considered low risk but flagged that kernel selectors may encode model-specific ids; added requirement to hash kernel_variant when exported to hosted telemetry (see security ticket: ENG-249100)
2025-03-03 — PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2128 — implements phase tagging and NVTX breadcrumb helper. Needs performance bench and integration tests.

2025-03-04 — Liam O'Reilly: Running cluster bench; initial results show 8.3x reduction in telemetry bytes and 12% CPU overhead on high-throughput paths. Plan to add adaptive sampling to only emit full per-kernel dumps for outlier requests.
notes: This is intended to be backward-compatible with current NVTX instrumentation. We will gate the feature behind runtime flags and a rollout plan for Dedicated customers. Follow-up ticket will implement adaptive sampling and an endpoint in the console to visualize weighted spans.
